title: The Broken Monsoon
author: Juniper Amberdale
blurb: Rosalind Hartwell, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
